[package]
workspace = "../../../../../.."
name = "semio-framework-io-schema"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
rust-version.workspace = true
description = "Product-neutral artifact identities, payloads and I/O outcomes"

[package.metadata.semio]
role = "framework"
id = "io-schema"

[lints]
workspace = true

[lib]
name = "semio_framework_io_schema"
path = "🦀️.rs"

[dependencies]
semio-framework-value = { path = "../../../../🌱️value/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-framework-value-derive = { path = "../../../../🌱️value/✨️derive/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-framework-diagnostic = { path = "../../../../⚠️diagnostic/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-framework-schema-registry = { path = "../../../../🧬️schema/📇️registry/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }

[dev-dependencies]
serde_json = "1.0.140"

//! 🚪️ Product-neutral I/O vocabulary with one definition owner.
#[path = "../../🦀️.rs"]
mod vocabulary;
pub use vocabulary::{
    StandardId,
    SubsetId,
    Dialect,
    ArtifactDialect,
    ArtifactKindId,
    ArtifactRef,
    is_canonical_artifact_kind,
    IoPayload,
    CARRIER_BINARY,
    CARRIER_TEXT,
    SQLITE_SNAPSHOT,
    Confidence,
    IoFidelity,
    IoError,
    IoOutcome,
    IoResult,
    IoEntryDescriptor,
    IoRoute,
    register_io_schema_exports,
};
